metadata.description: Personal pinned marketplace: every plugin here was source-reviewed and copied at a recorded commit (see README.md).

plugins.name: aurora-bridge
plugins.description: Bridge: heartbeat, per-call timeline, gate, agents, hot files, last turn, in the rice palette (first-party, v2)

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: Read-only live dashboard pane (scasella/claude-flightdeck) pinned at 626cc0b (v0.6.2)

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: File tree pane with git status (data-goblin/claude-code-filetree) pinned at 44d4a62

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Agent cockpit pane (drkokorev/cockpit-for-claude) pinned at 8960ed8, band and status line made optional, the guard starts off

plugins.name: paneline
plugins.description: Session pane with its own tabs (markneonin/paneline) pinned at fd20c8c, chat restyling made optional

plugins.name: cctop
plugins.description: btop-style dashboard pane (tomstagl/cctop, plugin/) pinned at 6ceafc3, open on start, quiet start and no status line options; never offers cctop install

plugins.name: prismantis
plugins.description: Reply renderer (NahumLitvin/prismantis) pinned at 0d93494 (v0.25.1), rice presets, tool rows, button copy, retro diffs

plugins.name: secret-box
plugins.description: Claude uses secrets without seeing them (ray-amjad/claude-code-mods, plugins/secret-box) pinned at 5d6bd15 (v0.5.14): masked box to .env, placeholders in and out, .env never committed; git messages read as text, USERPROFILE for a missing HOME, /secret-box on|off
